Ansari, positively identified for the first time, handed Kulkarni a folder of documents while addressing both him and Jadhav at the site office.
Ansari addressed Jadhav directly during the same site-office meeting where Kulkarni was handed documents.
Jadhav met Kulkarni directly at a tea stall near the records office and handed him papers relating to an unflagged landholding, with no mention of the fixer overheard.
Ansari handed Jadhav an envelope while continuing to speak with Kulkarni during a site-office meeting involving all three.
Ansari addressed Kulkarni together with Jadhav during the same site-office visit involving a payment arrangement.
Jadhav and Kulkarni met directly at the site office to coordinate an intimidation and documentation timeline for an unflagged landholding, without the fixer present.
Ansari reviewed documents with Kulkarni at the site office while Jadhav stood by, before addressing Jadhav directly.
Ansari addressed Jadhav directly regarding a new landholding after reviewing documents with Kulkarni, within the same site-office visit.

timeline.event_summary: Records-office verification found an ownership entry altered to transfer land to Shreeji Construction & Developers, filed by Advocate Kulkarni.
An informant identified an unrelated neighbour boundary-wall dispute as unconnected to the land-grabbing investigation.
An FIR was registered describing repeated pressure by Jadhav to vacate land and a subsequently discovered altered ownership record.
Field observation recorded Jadhav and Kulkarni meeting directly at a tea stall to hand over papers, with no fixer involvement.
Field observation positively identified the fixer as Iqbal Ansari meeting both Kulkarni and Jadhav together at the builder's site office.
A second landowner's complaint recorded the same pattern of intimidation and a similarly altered ownership record.
An informant reported Shreeji Construction & Developers taking possession of several additional plots following the established pattern.
A follow-up FIR recorded the fixer's positive identification as Iqbal Ansari and flagged further affected landholdings.
A follow-up FIR recorded independent informant corroboration of the fixer's identity as Iqbal Ansari.
Field observation recorded a second joint site-office meeting in which Ansari arranged a payment involving both Jadhav and Kulkarni.
An informant reported Jadhav and Kulkarni coordinating directly at the site office for a new landholding, without the fixer present.
An unrelated business-partner property dispute was verified as unconnected, alongside continued informant input on the network's ongoing activity.
Field observation recorded a third joint site-office meeting in which Ansari reviewed documents with Kulkarni and addressed Jadhav directly.
Field observation recorded a fourth joint meeting at a roadside dhaba involving Ansari, Jadhav, and Kulkarni.
An informant reported continued land acquisitions by Shreeji Construction & Developers and that the fixer was avoiding known meeting locations.
Jadhav and Kulkarni were apprehended in a coordinated action, leaving Ansari as the sole network figure still at large.

red_herrings.reason_excluded: The dispute concerns a boundary wall being handled through the civil courts, with no connection to Shreeji Construction & Developers or any individual under investigation.
Preliminary verification found the joint-ownership dispute had no connection to Shreeji Construction & Developers or to any of the individuals under investigation.
